take.en_definition: to carry or move something; to accept or receive

make.en_definition: to create or produce; to cause to happen

go.en_definition: to move from one place to another

examples.en: I go to school by bus.
Put the book on the desk.

turn.en_definition: to move around; to change direction

bring.en_definition: to carry something to a place

look.en_definition: to direct your eyes at something

run.en_definition: to move quickly on foot; to operate

think.en_definition: to use your mind to consider something

know.en_definition: to have information in your mind

work.en_definition: to do a job; a job or task

ask.en_definition: to say something to get information

help.en_definition: to make it easier for someone

leave.en_definition: to go away from a place

feel.en_definition: to experience an emotion or sensation

hold.en_definition: to carry or keep something in your hands

let.en_definition: to allow someone to do something

start.en_definition: to begin; to cause to begin

stop.en_definition: to make something end or not move

play.en_definition: to do something for fun; to take part in a game

set.en_definition: to put or place; to establish

read.en_definition: to look at and understand written words

write.en_definition: to make letters or words on paper

study.en_definition: to spend time learning; a room for reading

remember.en_definition: to keep something in your mind

eat.en_definition: to put food in your mouth and swallow

drink.en_definition: to take liquid into your mouth; a liquid for drinking

sleep.en_definition: to rest with your eyes closed

examples.en: I sleep eight hours a day.

clean.en_definition: to make free from dirt; not dirty

ride.en_definition: to travel on a bicycle or horse

examples.en: I ride a bike to school.

walk.en_definition: to move on foot; a journey on foot

open.en_definition: to move something so it is not closed; not closed

buy.en_definition: to get something by paying money

examples.en: I want to buy a book.

sell.en_definition: to give something in exchange for money

save.en_definition: to keep safe; to keep money for later

win.en_definition: to be successful in a competition

lose.en_definition: to not win; to misplace something

send.en_definition: to cause something to go somewhere

receive.en_definition: to get something that is sent to you

visit.en_definition: to go to see someone or a place

travel.en_definition: to go from one place to another

return.en_definition: to go back; to give back

examples.en: Return the book to the library.

carry.en_definition: to hold and move something from one place to another

catch.en_definition: to stop and hold something moving

throw.en_definition: to send something through the air with your hand

break.en_definition: to damage something; to separate into pieces

build.en_definition: to make something by putting parts together

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.

hope.en_definition: to want something to happen; a wish

discuss.en_definition: to talk about something with someone

explain.en_definition: to make something clear or easy to understand

examples.en: Can you explain this to me?

suggest.en_definition: to offer an idea or plan

offer.en_definition: to give something; to say you are willing to do something

promise.en_definition: to say you will definitely do something

examples.en: I expect to pass the exam.

plan.en_definition: a way of doing something; to make a plan

practice.en_definition: to do something repeatedly to improve

prefer.en_definition: to like one thing more than another

mind.en_definition: the thinking part; to care about

examples.en: Do you mind if I open the window?

care.en_definition: to feel concern; to look after

fear.en_definition: a strong bad feeling when you are in danger

examples.en: She has a fear of heights.

surprise.en_definition: an unexpected event; to make someone feel surprised

interest.en_definition: a feeling of wanting to know more

examples.en: I have an interest in art.

share.en_definition: to give a part of something to others

depend.en_definition: to rely on; to be decided by

include.en_definition: to have something as a part

cause.en_definition: to make something happen; a reason

matter.en_definition: a subject or situation; to be important

remain.en_definition: to stay in the same place or condition

examples.en: A ship appeared on the horizon.
examples.zh: 一艘船出现在地平线上。

follow.en_definition: to go after someone; to obey

lead.en_definition: to show the way; to be in charge

drive.en_definition: to operate a car; to force

handle.en_definition: to deal with; the part you hold

manage.en_definition: to be able to do something; to control

control.en_definition: to make something do what you want; power
